summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated bundled payload via downloaded Bun
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`, which runs an obfuscated loader (`_0x`-style hex identifiers, string-lookup indirection). On install, setup.mjs constructs the URL `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, downloads and extracts the Bun runtime to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')])`. The sibling `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun CJS bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and a large rotated string array with a rotator function — obfuscator.io-style packing that hides its actual behavior. An ESLint configuration package has no legitimate need for a second runtime or a 727KB opaque init script; the alternate runtime is the mechanism used to execute the obfuscated bundle outside the Node/npm-visible tooling. This fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
